newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - CHINESE NEWSPAPERS - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CHINESE NEWSPAPERS - AUG 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Article lists major events since 14th Communist Party Congress in October 1992.
- First of a series of articles reports on the achievements of cities in promoting social morals, a clean environment, good services and orderly transport.
- State Tourism Administration says income from tourism totalled $5.48 billion in the first half of the year, up 15.59 percent compared with the same period of 1996.
- A large photo album titled "The People's Army" is published.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH

- President Jiang Zemin sends telegram to Fidel Ramos, president of the Philippines and chairman of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN), congratulating him on the 30th anniversary of ASEAN.
- China's annual colour television output capacity is more than 30 million units while domestic demand is less than 20 million units.
CHINA SECURITIES
- Turnover of real estate in Zhuhai city hits 250,000 square metres in first half, up 15.5 percent year-on-year.
- State Commission for Restructuring the Economy calls for growth in foreign trade to be accelerated.
- Economist Wei Jie says shareholding system is solution to capital problems of state firms.
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Pacific Insurance Co insurance business income hits 6.742 billion yuan in first half, up 44.23 percent year-on-year.
- Vice President of People's Bank of China Yin Jieyan says cooperative financial institutions in rural areas to curb financial risks in 1997 and 1998.
- Chairman of Beijing Securities Association Lu Kequn calls for regulation of stock markets.
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- China's international container handling capacity hits 1.12 million TFUs (twenty-foot equivalent units) in first half, up 31.3 percent year-on-year.
- Construction to start this year on Guangdong-Hainan railway with total investment of 4.518 billion yuan.
ECONOMIC DAILY
- China to set up first mobile phone production base in Shenzhen with total investment of 250 million yuan.
CHINA DAILY
- China develops modern logistics equipment and facilities for crack units of the People's Liberation Army.
- China remains positive about the establishment of a peace process on the Korean Peninsula in talks between China, the United States, North Korea and South Korea.
- Pakistani President Farooq Leghari says relations between Pakistan and China are a model of inter-state relations.
- United States National Security Advisor Sandy Berger to fly to China this weekend to prepare for President Jiang Zemin's visit to Washington later this year.
